title: 生涯スポーツ演習(初心者スキー)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports(Skiing for Beginners)
courseType:
Student and Study Skills Courses Program
Character Building Courses
Lifelong Sports
educationalGoal: By studying the fundamental skills of skiing, students will learn the following: 1. The enjoyment of sports throughout their lifetime. 2. The knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily and through their own initiative based on the Plan-Do-Check-Action (PDCA) cycle. 3. Necessities for social/student life such as the observation of rules, respect and kindness for others, a competitive spirit, leadership/cooperation, a sense of responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice: This class aims to achieve the above-mentioned learning objectives through skiing activities. Students will learn various skills such as putting on/taking off skis, stopping, and turning. Students will be grouped according to skill level. This class is conducted at other prefectures (Niigata) in late January or early February as a 3-day/2-night intensive course. Students should have appropriate waterproof clothing for winter activities (e.g., ski clothes, hat, gloves) and protection from the cold in the mountains. Students should bring goggles or sunglasses. Ski equipment is available for rent at the hotel. Students are responsible for all expenses (e.g., transportation, hotel, meals, lift ticket). Because this course involves outdoor activities in the mountains during winter, students should carefully observe the rules (e.g., meeting times, preparation of appropriate equipment).
requiredKnowledge: Because this course involves outdoor activities in the mountains during winter, students should prepare the appropriate equipment well in advance.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying sports lifestyle throughout your own lifetime.
Be able to learn fundamental skills needed for skiing and use them in class activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this understanding in learning activities.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Accurately express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2) Learn fundamental skiing skills and utilize them fully in class activities. (3) Accurately evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4) Understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities. (5) Accurately express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and implement this understanding in learning activities.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Roughly express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2) Learn fundamental skiing skills and utilize them roughly in class activities. (3) Roughly evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4) Understand the necessities for social life and roughly implement them in class activities. (5) Roughly express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and roughly implement this understanding in learning activities.
